neighbours.label: a government committing to pay for or provide something (pledged to cover the cost, provide for)
fire: Congress promised to cover forty percent of the cost of the program.
The state agreed to pay for school meals for every child.
The ministry pledged to fund half of the new hospital wing.
Under the treaty, each member must provide for the defense of its borders.
The federal government will cover the cost of the cleanup.
The council voted to provide for free bus passes for pensioners.
Washington pledged to finance the rebuilding of the bridges.
The new law obliges the state to pay for flood insurance in poor areas.
quiet: Congress debated the program for forty minutes on Tuesday.
The state published the school meal menus for every child.
The ministry opened the new hospital wing last spring.
Under the treaty, each member must report the length of its borders.
The federal government announced the cleanup would begin soon.
The council voted to repaint the bus shelters near the station.
Washington sent engineers to inspect the bridges.
The new law describes the flood risk in poor areas.
